@mrT23 I am not so sure I fully understand the purpose of the request. The environment variables are passed down by Bitbucket as described here: https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/variables-and-secrets/ 

Given that we no longer use Docker in Docker here, additional variables can be exposed by adding them to the Bitbucket Variables and Secrets.

Adding them directly into the CLI command risks exposing the secret values in the logs. 

I am happy to add this as additional description, but am hesitant to revert this part of the change because not using Docker in Docker was the intention for this PR.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
This itself if quite meaningless without also removing Docker in Docker. Using the double underscore convention enables to remove Docker in Docker by configuring the Bitbucket Variables so that they can be understood by `codiumai/pr-agent` when passed into the container. (Bitbucket does not support dots in Bitbucket Variables.)

The main purpose is to remove Docker in Docker for two reasons:

1. Longer time to start the Pipeline step as it is defined right now requires to run a parent container and then pull and run codiumai/pr-agent instead of simply running codiumai/pr-agent (we can also make use of the cash on the Bitbucket runtime side)
2. Less overhead by not wrapping containers (and it avoids potential competing for resources among other fun side effect we don't really need to be concerned about in this simple setup though)
